personas.name: Relationship Manager
personas.description: A front-office banker who manages a portfolio of personal or business banking clients. They use CRM and banking platforms to review account activity, initiate credit proposals, support onboarding, and coordinate product delivery across retail and commercial lines. Their access spans customer data and product origination tools.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 2,000–5,000 relationship managers bank-wide across retail and commercial divisions.

personas.name: Credit Analyst
personas.description: A specialist who assesses the creditworthiness of business lending applications, counterparty exposures, and portfolio credit risk. They consume financial models, credit scoring outputs, and market data to produce credit committee papers and support annual reviews for commercial customers.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 200–500 credit analysts across commercial, structured finance, and portfolio risk teams.

personas.name: Compliance Officer
personas.description: A second-line risk professional responsible for monitoring adherence to FCA/PRA regulatory requirements, AML/KYC controls, conduct obligations, sanctions screening, and data protection. They have broad read access across capabilities to investigate alerts, review transactions, and prepare regulatory submissions.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 300–600 compliance professionals across first-line, second-line, and specialist financial crime teams.

personas.name: Treasury Dealer
personas.description: A front-office Markets professional who executes FX, money market, and interest rate derivative transactions to manage the bank's balance sheet, funding position, and customer hedging requirements. They interact with real-time pricing systems, electronic trading platforms, and SWIFT confirmation flows.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 30–80 treasury and markets dealers across FX spot, FX forwards, rates, and money markets desks.

personas.name: Fraud Analyst
personas.description: An operations specialist who investigates real-time fraud alerts generated by the fraud detection engine, reviews card disputes, handles account takeover cases, and feeds confirmed fraud patterns back into detection models. They hold access to full transaction history and can action account restrictions.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 200–400 fraud operations analysts working across real-time detection queues and case management systems.

personas.name: Mortgage Underwriter
personas.description: A specialist underwriter who assesses residential mortgage applications, reviews affordability calculations, property valuations, and credit bureau data, and makes or recommends lending decisions. They work within defined credit policy parameters and escalate exceptions to senior credit management.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 200–500 mortgage underwriters, with workloads driven by application pipeline volumes.

personas.name: Branch Staff
personas.description: A customer-facing colleague working in a physical branch who assists personal and small business customers with account queries, cash handling, document verification for onboarding, product applications, and referrals to specialist advisors. They use the branch teller and CRM systems as primary tools.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 3,000–8,000 branch staff across the UK branch network.

personas.name: Wealth Advisor
personas.description: A qualified investment adviser or financial planner (typically CII-qualified) who works with HNW and mass-affluent clients to deliver financial planning, investment recommendations, and portfolio reviews. They use the wealth management platform to access client portfolios, model scenarios, and produce suitability documentation.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 300–700 wealth advisors and private bankers across the wealth and private banking division.

personas.name: Operations Staff
personas.description: A back-office payments operations specialist who monitors payment queues, investigates exceptions and returns, manages cut-off processing, handles CHAPS investigations, and performs nostro reconciliation. They work within strict SLA windows aligned to payment scheme deadlines.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 300–600 operations staff across Faster Payments, BACS, CHAPS, international, and card operations teams.

personas.name: Senior Manager (SMF)
personas.description: An individual holding a Senior Management Function under the FCA/PRA Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SM&CR). They have accountability for one or more regulated areas and require oversight access across all capability domains — primarily through management information, board reporting, and executive dashboards — rather than transactional access.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 30–80 designated SMF holders across the group, including Chief Executive, Chief Risk Officer, Chief Compliance Officer, and divisional MDs.

personas.name: IT Operations
personas.description: Infrastructure and platform engineers responsible for operating, monitoring, and maintaining the bank's technology estate. They manage core banking platform availability, payment system health, cloud infrastructure, incident response, patching, and DR/BCP testing. They hold elevated access to platform and foundation services but do not interact with customer data in the normal course of duties.
personas.volume_estimate: Approximately 300–700 IT operations, platform engineering, and site reliability engineers across infrastructure, cloud, and application support teams.
